A_recommended_typed_fidelity.rationale: Eight-significant-digit rendering bound; exact zero avoids erasing tiny observed nonzero WATT/VAR values; not sensor uncertainty.

B_six_decimal_compatibility.rationale: Half a unit at six decimal places; less strict for small quantities; retain zero/sign gates and scientific notation near zero.

percent_unit: percentage points; baseline zero unavailable; no inferred denominator floor
profile_selection_scope: candidate specification only; not an activated evaluator
minimum_numeric_serialization: eight significant digits or round-trip; preserve zero and sign

support_matching.declaration: fields.support_form; a missing form means EXACT
support_matching.exact: A fact is retrieval-supported only when at least one acceptable support set is contained in the visible evidence.
support_matching.existential: A fact is retrieval-supported when at least one visible record matches fields.support_predicate. Stored acceptable support sets are reviewed witnesses and are not an exhaustive enumeration.
support_matching.role_based: A fact is retrieval-supported when every fields.support_roles predicate matches at least one record visible in the same scored view. Stored acceptable support sets are reviewed witnesses and are not an exhaustive enumeration.
support_matching.quality_valid: quality_flags compared by exact equality; an empty list is the quality-valid measurement condition when the fact stores no other quality value
support_matching.rule: Retrieval support is evaluated according to the semantic support form of the gold proposition: exact-support facts require an accepted exact support set; existential facts require at least one visible record satisfying the accepted proposition predicate; role-based facts require at least one visible record for every required role. Concrete support sets retained on existential or role-based facts are reviewed witnesses and are not exhaustive enumerations.
